India’s rupee has become an accidental carry star
Markets.summary: Falling oil prices and shifting foreign investments have temporarily transformed the Indian rupee into an attractive option for carry traders. However, this trend may be short-lived because the Reserve Bank of India's incentives are temporary and India's interest rate advantage has significantly decreased since 2011.

Markets.title: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded sharply on Monday, led by a 31% surge in Nvidia after Jensen Huang was reinstated as chief executive under pressure from President Donald Trump. At the same time, Treasury yields and the dollar climbed as investors reassessed artificial intelligence sentiment and the Federal Reserve outlook.

Markets.title: NSEL releases Rs 1,950 crore in one-time settlement, ends 14-year payment default
Markets.summary: National Spot Exchange Ltd has paid Rs 1,950 crore to eligible claimants in a one-time settlement approved by the National Company Law Tribunal. This payout resolves a 14-year-old legal battle resulting from a Rs 5,600 crore payment crisis.

Markets.title: Nasdaq surges 6%, Dow soars 1,400 pts as markets rebound on Huang’s return: Stock Market Live Updates
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq surged 6% and the Dow soared 1,400 points as the stock market rebounded. This major rally was driven by the return of Jensen Huang.

Markets.title: Adani Airport raises $300 mn from 360 ONE Asset, taking total equity infusion to $1.35 bn
Markets.summary: Adani Airport Holdings is raising $300 million from 360 ONE Asset, bringing its total equity infusion to $1.35 billion. The new funds will be used to modernize infrastructure and expand passenger capacity from 96 million to 200 million.

Geo-Political.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal
Geo-Political.summary: The United States plans to blacklist the Asian artificial intelligence firm Megaspeed. This action follows allegations that the company funneled restricted AI chips to China after a former executive's personal relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was exposed.

Geo-Political.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war

Geo-Political.summary: A recent Oxfam report states that Israeli attacks have left Gaza as a "toxic wasteland" with signs of contamination across almost the entire territory. The pollution threatens the health of residents and severely compromises the area's environment.

Data & Insights.title: India-UK trade deal cuts Scotch whisky duty to 75%, but bulk imports face 110% levy; Govt working to resolve dispute
Data & Insights.summary: An India-UK trade deal reduces the import duty on bottled Scotch whisky to 75%. However, a dispute remains because bulk spirit imports intended for dilution and bottling in India still face a 110% levy.

Data & Insights.title: Fertilizer subsidy may rise 15% to  ₹2.5 trillion even as sales fall 8%
Data & Insights.summary: India's fertilizer subsidy bill is projected to rise 15% to ₹2.5 trillion in FY27 as global prices climb. This increase is expected despite an 8% drop in sales between April and October and lower annual consumption driven by deficient monsoon rains.

Data & Insights.title: New GDP, CPI and IIP series to help make better-calibrated policy decisions, says RBI's Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: According to RBI's Poonam Gupta, updated GDP, CPI, and IIP series will improve economic policy decisions. The revised methodologies aim to stabilize early estimates, minimize data revisions, and clarify structural and cyclical economic shifts.

Data & Insights.title: India's private sector growth set to hold up in November: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector growth is projected to remain steady in November according to HSBC's Flash India Purchasing Managers' Index. Demand across the country's private sector improved at its fastest rate since June.

Data & Insights.title: The quiet boom in investing by Indian women, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Over the past five years, Indian women have increased their participation in both low-risk bank deposits and high-risk equity funds. Despite this growth, achieving overall financial gender parity remains a distant goal.

Data & Insights.title: Protein prices bite as food inflation squeezes Indian households
Data & Insights.summary: Food inflation more than doubles since April, with prices of proteins such as milk, pulses, meats and eggs soaring.

India.summary: Prime Minister Modi announced the establishment of a new IIT campus, startup incubator, and innovation hub in Nepal. This initiative aims to expand educational and economic opportunities for youth while strengthening cooperation between India and Nepal.

India.title: CISCE Hosts First National Student Mental Health Conclave, Puts Learners At The Centre
India.summary: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations held its first National Student Mental Health and Well-Being Conclave in Hyderabad. The event brought students together to help shape mental health support systems in schools.

India.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke alleged that Saurav Das was prevented from boarding a flight to the United Kingdom at the Delhi airport. Dipke claimed this action occurred because someone in power was jealous of Das receiving an invitation from the University of Oxford.

India.title: S Jaishankar Holds Phone Conversation With Russian Counterpart Lavrov
India.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov discussed the Russia-Ukraine conflict during a phone call on Monday. Their conversation focused on finding a peaceful resolution to the ongoing war.

General.summary: BBC reporter Lily Jamali is at Nvidia's headquarters to gauge the company's reaction to Jensen Huang's return as CEO. This follows Donald Trump's statement that he brokered a deal regarding the leadership change.
